groups.problem: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined first destination calendar when the destination array is empty or absent.
groups.rationale: All seven suggestions identify the unguarded integration access at EventManager.ts:119. They describe the same failure and are resolved by guarding that access.

groups.problem: Google calendar update and delete fallbacks search for the already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the intended destination-calendar fallback.
groups.rationale: The identical faulty selection pattern occurs in updateEvent and deleteEvent and requires correction at both locations. S9 and S10 report individual occurrences; S12 and S2 report the same repeated defect across both.
